title: ¡A lavar las frutas gigantes! 🍎🍌🍐 | Aprende los colores con Tito #Shorts
room: A sunny green garden, vertical 9:16 composition, camera at child eye level: soft green grass, colorful flowers, a small apple tree and a little white fence, a soft rainbow in the blue sky. On the grass stands a big round shallow wooden tub full of clear water and soft white soap bubbles. Floating in the tub: a GIANT shiny red apple, a GIANT yellow banana and a GIANT green pear, each fruit as big as a toddler. Plain real fruit. Nobody is in the garden.
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Splash! ¡Frutas gigantes!
[Verse]
¿Las lavamos? ¡Sí, sí, sí!
Manzana roja, ¡splash, splash!

Pera verde, ¡splash, splash!
[Outro]
¡Limpias y ricas! ¡Mmm!
